programs.showName: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
programs.description: Joel Barish discovers that the love of his life, Clementine, has had him erased from her memory. To pay her back in the same coin, poor Joel undergoes an intricate medical procedure to do the same.
Maria Altman, a Jewish refugee, along with her lawyer Randy Schoenberg, faces several difficulties while reclaiming the painting of her aunt, which was seized by the Nazis before World War II.
Charlie's deceased mum's spirit sends him to Bucharest, where he fulfils a promise to a fellow passenger who dies mid-flight.

A demanding choir master at an elite East Coast boarding school pushes a gifted but troubled orphan to fulfil his true potential.
Nick Carraway arrives in New York in 1922. Chasing his own American Dream, Nick is drawn into the captivating world of the super-rich, their illusions, loves and deceits.
While wealthy suitors excite her ambitious mother, independent Elizabeth Bennet cleverly counters proud Mr Darcy. Consequently, sharp debates ensue.
Whilst on a mission to transform the mainstream rock and roll culture of the USA, singer Elvis Presley uses his fame to highlight racism within the country.
Documentary follows Jennifer Lopez's personal and professional journey during her first global tour. Later, it reveals behind-the-scenes moments on and off-stage.
With support from his loving wife Gerda (Alicia Vikander), artist Einar Wegener (Eddie Redmayne) prepares to undergo one of the first sex-change operations.
The husband of Margaret Keane, a phenomenal painter, wrongfully claims credit for her works and enjoys her success until a legal battle between the two reveals the truth to the world.
Hank, a prison guard, is a part of convicted murderer Lawrence Musgrove's execution, but when he meets Leticia, a Black woman, he becomes smitten with her, unaware that she is Musgrove's widow.
After a devastating accident shatters his world, a once-celebrated champion boxer spirals into a destructive abyss. Subsequently, he decides to fight for his daughter and revive his fading career.
Julie Powell, a young blogger, is determined to emulate Julia Child's cooking techniques. Though separated by time, the two women share a common passion for food that intertwines their lives.

Los Angeles denizen Louis Bloom survives by scavenging and petty theft. He stumbles into a new career as a cameraman and armed with a camcorder and police scanner begins nocturnal forays across the city in search of shocking and grisly crimes. When he catches the eye of a shopworn news director who welcomes the chance to raise her stations ratings Louis goes to increasingly greater lengths to catch the money shot.
Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

Wealthy speedboat racer Ben Aronoff leads a secret life that lands him in trouble with both law enforcement and drug lords.
When a man with HIV is fired by his law firm because of his condition, he hires a homophobic small-time lawyer as the only willing advocate for a wrongful dismissal suit.
Two friends and fellow magicians become bitter enemies after a sudden tragedy. However, as they devote themselves to this rivalry, they make sacrifices that bring them fame and terrible consequences.
